generator.prompt_summary: Tail-attachment revision of the puppet miko Ringpet concept. The fox tail now emerges from behind the right hip / lower back and overlaps the skirt and waist armor so it no longer reads as detached on the magenta source.

postprocess.note: The generated raw source background was a magenta gradient rather than exact flat #ff00ff. Soft matte removal damaged red/plum subject colors, so the accepted alpha uses a conservative hard key plus 1px edge contraction. The repo magenta_source output was then recomposited from the accepted alpha onto exact opaque #ff00ff.

qa.detached_tail_check: Tail root overlaps the right hip / skirt area and reads as attached on both magenta-source and alpha previews.
